stage0092_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$カレン$$
「A sky dark even at midday...
　A cityscape like a movie set...
　No doubt about it.」

stage0092_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「We were... fighting in space, but...
　why are we somewhere like this?」

stage0092_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Is this the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$'s doing?」

stage0092_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$ニア$$ said it was a system, but...」

stage0092_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$桂$$
「Might be what they call... Taiji's power.」

stage0092_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$桂$$
「...Last time I came here, my mind was foggy,
　but now I get it, a little.」

stage0092_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（The true singularity, $$桂木桂$$...
　It seems he intuitively grasps the true nature
　of this city where dimensions intersect...）

stage0092_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$桂$$
「Taiji... the principle underlying
　the whole universe... the will that governs
　the start and end of all things...」

stage0092_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$桂$$
「That's what $$アサキム$$ said, in this city.」

stage0092_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$...!」

stage0092_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$スザク$$
「A dimensional wanderer who hunts $$スフィア$$...
　A cursed, immortal man...」

stage0092_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$カレン$$
「That man's now in an unending sleep
　in Mars' 《$$ＺＯＮＥ$$》, thanks to Crowe...」

stage0092_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$桂$$, have you been to
　this Paradigm City with that guy before?」

stage0092_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$桂$$
「According to $$アサキム$$'s words,
　this Paradigm City is a sandbox
　built by Taiji's will...」

stage0092_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$桂$$
「Apparently, it's nothing more than a laboratory
　for creating new worlds.」

stage0092_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$カレン$$
「You mean someone built this city?
　Then that's why its people have no memories...」

stage0092_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$葵$$
「So what exactly is this Taiji thing!?」

stage0092_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$桂$$
「...You've all heard the name before, haven't you?」

stage0092_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$甲児$$
「Now that you mention it, I've heard
　that $$スフィア$$ are fragments of Taiji...!」

stage0092_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So basically, someone used a power
　that lets them do anything, and built this city
　however they pleased?」

stage0092_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Then I guess that explains a little
　about this baffling city.」

stage0092_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What is this experiment?
　Why did whoever uses this 'Taiji'
　build Paradigm City?」

stage0092_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$桂$$
「Cut off from the outside, memories stripped away,
　the days pass without any sense of time...」

stage0092_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$シモン$$
「Is this Paradigm City
　a testing ground for $$エタニティ・フラット$$...!?」

stage0092_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$カレン$$
「Then the one who holds Taiji is $$ガドライト$$...!」

stage0092_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$スザク$$
「He does use Taiji... the $$スフィア$$.」

stage0092_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$甲児$$
「Is he the one who brought us here, too...?」

stage0092_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$タケル$$
「And what triggers the system's activation...」

stage0092_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$桂$$
「No use thinking about it here.
　Let's start by looking around.」

stage0092_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$桂$$
「This is Paradigm City.
　So the one we can count on most is him.」

stage0092_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「...Soon, his power will be needed...」

stage0092_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's outside Paradigm City's dome...」

stage0092_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$カミーユ$$, $$バナージ$$ and I
　woke up outside this same dome before,
　the last time we got sent to Paradigm City.」

stage0092_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But why... just the three of us...」

stage0092_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「We haven't often met like this before.
　Well then, let me introduce myself.」

stage0092_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「My name is $$シュバルツバルト$$.
　A seeker of truth.」

stage0092_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$バナージ$$
「This bizarre man, a seeker of truth...」

stage0092_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「I understand your concern too, $$バナージ・リンクス$$.」

stage0092_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$バナージ$$
「How do you know my name...!?」

stage0092_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Of course, yours isn't the only name I know.
　$$アムロ・レイ$$, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$, $$シン・アスカ$$...」

stage0092_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$シン$$
「Just who the hell are you!?」

stage0092_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「I told you, didn't I?
　I'm a seeker of truth... wandering this world
　in search of all knowledge, past and present.」

stage0092_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Then tell us.
　Why are we here?
　What is this scene spreading outside the dome?」

stage0092_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「I'll answer both questions in one word.」

stage0092_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$」

stage0092_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Oh, let me be precise with my words.
　This Nuclear Winter was the work
　of one $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

stage0092_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What do you mean by that!?」

stage0092_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「You should already know the answer.
　That's right... the Moon's Record Keeper
　told you of his true deeds, didn't he?」

stage0092_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$シン$$
「A future where Captain $$クワトロ$$...
　fights Captain $$アムロ$$...」

stage0092_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「That's right!
　This scene is the true world... the truth!」

stage0092_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$シン$$
「Where do you think you're going!?
　We're not finished talking!」

stage0092_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「See the truth beyond this point with your own eyes!
　My role, too, is almost at its end!」

stage0092_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$シン$$
「Damn it!
　Some 'seeker of truth' he is!
　His goal was just to mislead us!」

stage0092_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Anyway, let's head to the dome.
　Everyone's probably there.」

stage0092_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n... this is a place for drinking...」

stage0092_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「We should hurry and find everyone, and regroup...」

stage0092_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$n
「...So you can hear it too, Miss $$スズネ$$.
　His voice.」

stage0092_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$...」

stage0092_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Glad you came, $F.
　Mind if I call you $n too?」

stage0092_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$n
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$...
　And $$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$...」

stage0092_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Anyway, thanks for answering my invitation...」

stage0092_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's quite some speed, huh...
　But a flesh-and-blood fist won't take me down.」

stage0092_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Let me be clear, it's nothing like a cyborg.
　This is what we are... Geminaids.」

stage0092_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「We're from planet Geminai.
　As you see, the men can turn their skin metallic.」

stage0092_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Surprised?
　The galaxy's full of things you don't know about.」

stage0092_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「We've both got company today.
　Let's skip the rough stuff for now.
　...Go on, sit down.」

stage0092_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Well then, if you'll excuse me.」

stage0092_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So, this young lady here,
　is she your sister?」

stage0092_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I see.
　So she came along because she was worried about you, huh?」

stage0092_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Want something to drink?
　The whiskey selection here isn't bad.」

stage0092_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Ah... I see.
　So that's this Earth rule of yours.」

stage0092_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Living bound by rules like that
　sounds so stifling, though...」

stage0092_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$n
「What business did you call me here for?」

stage0092_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「From what $$アンナロッタ$$ says,
　apparently you and I are alike.」

stage0092_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「My beloved honey said so, after all.
　Figured I'd get a good look at your face
　before our decisive battle.」

stage0092_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「And that's something you'd want too, isn't it?」

stage0092_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$n
「...Have you decided to settle things with us?」

stage0092_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Just as I declared, sometime after November 11th.」

stage0092_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't take the bait, $n.
　If we get pulled into his pace, we lose.」

stage0092_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...Seems like your partner
　has a clearer read on the situation.」

stage0092_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Then let me ask you something too.
　That imitation of yours... just what is it?」

stage0092_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Even the name's a copy, huh...
　That thing's clearly a rip-off of my $$ジェミニア$$.」

stage0092_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$n
「From what I've heard,
　that's a prototype built by a company
　called $$ＤＥＭ$$ that operates across dimensions.」

stage0092_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$n
「I pilot $$ジェニオン$$ to defeat you.」

stage0092_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So you mean to defeat me, then insist
　the imitation is the real thing?」

stage0092_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$n
「$$ＤＥＭ$$'s schemes are none of my concern.
　I just can't forgive you for taking
　my father and sister's lives...!」

stage0092_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$n
「Not just my father and sister...
　For $$シンヤ$$, $$ミサコ$$... everyone cursed
　by the angel, I'll defeat you!」

stage0092_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「An angel, huh...
　That doesn't really suit me, though...」

stage0092_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$n
「Just so you know, that's not the only
　reason I'm fighting you.」

stage0092_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Because I'm this world's enemy, huh...
　Well... fair enough.」

stage0092_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「How about it, $n...?
　Meeting like this must be some kind of fate...
　Want me to tell you something good?」

stage0092_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「This world's singularity...
　You want to know, don't you?」

stage0092_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$スズネ$$
「The singularity...
　If only we knew that, we might be able
　to break the Prison of Time...」

stage0092_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well, I can't go telling you everything,
　but I'll give you a hint at least.」

stage0092_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't flatter yourself.
　What value is there in the life of someone
　I could kill right here, right now, if I wanted?」

stage0092_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If you want the answer...
　how about you bow your head to me?」

stage0092_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Guess you can't, huh...
　bowing to someone you hate enough to kill.」

stage0092_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I get it, $n.
　That you're a proud man.」

stage0092_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「And here you are, with a woman in tow...」

stage0092_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$n
「...Please...
　Give me the hint about the singularity...」

stage0092_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Buhahahahaha!
　This guy actually went and did it!」

stage0092_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Just kidding, honey.
　Even I'm not that much of a scumbag.」

stage0092_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「This world's singularity you two are looking for...」

stage0092_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's someone you two know very well.」

stage0092_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You two are $$烙印$$-bearers, after all.
　Power just naturally gathers there.」

stage0092_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「$n... you can raise your head.
　Once you've said thanks, that is.」

stage0092_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Off he goes, huh...
　Well... can't blame him.」

stage0092_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Is that all right?
　Giving away information about the singularity.」

stage0092_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Doesn't matter to me.
　Even if they reach the answer,
　that's only half of it anyway.」

stage0092_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「The singularities will never fully align...
　And more importantly, this city's where
　they and the world both end.」

stage0092_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Still, seeing him face to face,
　I really understood what you meant.」

stage0092_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Inside him, despair that would bow to me
　clashed against hope to save the world...」

stage0092_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I don't know the circumstances behind
　why he's piloting an imitation, but
　he's got what it takes, no doubt.」

stage0092_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「So that's why he could hear your call...」

stage0092_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well... shall we go watch their final battle...」

stage0092_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ガドライト$$
（This ought to satisfy him, at least...）

stage0092_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Then, I will too...」

stage0092_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Playing captain now, after all this time?」

stage0092_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's for the future of the one in your belly...
　no, for the future of the Geminaids.」

stage0092_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text: ～ $$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$'s Residence ～

stage0092_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「...I was glad you came to visit,
　$$ロジャー・スミス$$.」

stage0092_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Giving my client a progress report
　is a negotiator's duty, after all.」

stage0092_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Though it's a shame I never got to taste
　your prized tomatoes.」

stage0092_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「The harvest season's already past.
　The tomatoes have left my hands now.」

stage0092_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「...Winter will be here soon...
　And she, out of sorrow and loneliness,
　is trying to forget everything...」

stage0092_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Paradigm City's memory...
　Or, in other words, her, the city itself... $$エンジェル$$...」

stage0092_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「That's right...
　That's the truth of this city, the world's
　collapse, recorded at the end of '《$$メトロポリス$$》'...」

stage0092_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's precisely the activation of the
　system someone left behind...」

stage0092_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$...
　You too once took all manner of steps
　to recover that memory.」

stage0092_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「I wanted to know who made me write $$メトロポリス$$.
　But that's an old story now.」

stage0092_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「Looking back at the past won't change it...
　Once you realize that, you understand
　memory means nothing at all.」

stage0092_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「The ring of 12,000 years will close soon.
　But this city has nothing to do with that...」

stage0092_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「You didn't accept that as it was.
　That's why you gave me your message.」

stage0092_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ゴードン$$
「What comes after... the future isn't
　for an old man to decide.」

stage0092_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Understood, $$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$.
　...I just hope she comes to understand that too...」

stage0092_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see any job I take through to the end.
　That's my way, and my pride.」

stage0092_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Because I am $$ロジャー・スミス$$...
　Paradigm City's, no, the world's negotiator.」

stage0092_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Came to pick me up, $$ドロシー#240$$?」

stage0092_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「That's right.
　It's already time for work.」

stage0092_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then let's go, R. $$ドロシー#240$$.
　To carry out our duty.」

stage0092_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Wait for me, $$エンジェル$$.」

stage0092_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The triangle that strengthens $$ミカゲ$$'s power of hatred...
　The key to it seems to lie within $c」

stage0092_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The 100 Z-Chips born from this battle,
　I've added to the squad's stock.
　I'm sure this must be the hint.」

stage0092_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Though I suppose this isn't the time for that...」

stage0092_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Battle after battle, one after another...
　Lately, no sooner do you down one foe
　than the next appears, dragging you all over.」

stage0092_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But it seems the next one is the decisive battle.
　I hope that means we can settle down a little...」

stage0092_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:

「...Though I guess this isn't the time to say that.
